name: g_slotReelColumnOffset
comment: Column offset of each of the five slot reels inside one interleaved symbol row. Casino_Slot_PickStopBySymbol reads table[reel] and then looks at strip[row*5 + table[reel]]; in the retail image the five words are the identity 0,1,2,3,4.
evidence: Casino_Slot_PickStopBySymbol (0x0064BFC8) loads the table through literal slot 0x0064C2CC (ARM: ldr r0,=0x0072AB4C; ldr r1,[r0,r1,lsl #2]) and uses it as the byte column in `*(u8*)(row*5 + *reel_data + table[reel])`; the five retail words at 0x0072AB4C are 0,1,2,3,4 and reel indices are 0..4.

name: g_slotJackpotDelegate
comment: Two-word C++ pointer-to-member-function delegate {function = Ui_Delegate_BindActionB, this-adjust = 0}. Casino_Slot_BuildPayoutSequence copies both words into the +0x10/+0x14 fields of the jackpot node, whose exec Ui_Delegate_Invoke then calls the function.
evidence: Casino_Slot_BuildPayoutSequence (0x003283B4) does `puVar8 = g_00328e4c; puVar3[4] = puVar8[0]; puVar3[5] = puVar8[1]` for the jackpot node; literal 0x00328E4C resolves to 0x0072AC78; word0 = 0x003805E4 (Ui_Delegate_BindActionB), word1 = 0; the node's own table (0x00766030, literal 0x00328E48) has slot +8 = 0x0038060C Ui_Delegate_Invoke, which dispatches exactly this {fn, adjust} pair (adjust bit0 = virtual).

name: g_slotWinTextLine0Vtable
comment: Method table for line 0 of the slot machine's win-message text. Word +8 is Ui_MessageVoice_UpdateLine0, which starts/reveals the text stream and plays the completion SE; Casino_Slot_BuildPayoutSequence allocates a 0x2F-byte voice node and registers it on animation slot +0x47C.
evidence: Casino_Slot_BuildPayoutSequence stores 0x0075E0AC (literal 0x00328AA8) in the node's first word and registers that node at self+0x47C; table words are +0 = 0x00299AE0 unlink thunk, +8 = 0x006D4EDC Ui_MessageVoice_UpdateLine0; the node's +0x10 float (+0xBF800000 = -1.0f), +0x14 byte and +0x18 handle match the MessageVoice layout that function uses.

name: g_slotWinTextLine1Vtable
comment: Method table for line 1 of the slot machine's win-message text (word +8 = Ui_MessageVoice_UpdateLine1). Registered by Casino_Slot_BuildPayoutSequence on animation slot +0x494 with a 0x2F-byte voice node.
evidence: Literal 0x00328AAC -> 0x0075E0D4 is written to node+0 and registered at self+0x494 by Casino_Slot_BuildPayoutSequence; slot +8 = 0x006D5128 Ui_MessageVoice_UpdateLine1, the line-1 sibling of 0x006D4EDC (only the line index differs).

name: g_slotWinTextLine2Vtable
comment: Method table for line 2 of the slot machine's win-message text (word +8 = Ui_MessageVoice_UpdateLine2). Registered by Casino_Slot_BuildPayoutSequence on animation slot +0x4AC with a 0x2F-byte voice node.
evidence: Literal 0x00328AB4 -> 0x0075E0FC is stored in the node and registered at self+0x4AC by Casino_Slot_BuildPayoutSequence; slot +8 = 0x006D546C Ui_MessageVoice_UpdateLine2, the line-2 sibling of the same voice updater family.

name: g_slotWinTextLine3Vtable
comment: Method table for line 3 of the slot machine's win-message text (word +8 = Ui_MessageVoice_UpdateLine3). Registered by Casino_Slot_BuildPayoutSequence on animation slot +0x4C4 with a 0x2F-byte voice node.
evidence: Literal 0x00328ABC -> 0x0075E124 is stored in the node and registered at self+0x4C4 by Casino_Slot_BuildPayoutSequence; slot +8 = 0x006D57B0 Ui_MessageVoice_UpdateLine3, the line-3 sibling of the same voice updater family.

name: g_slotWinTextLine4Vtable
comment: Method table for the last (line 4) win-message text: word +8 is Ui_MessageVoice_FinishLine4, which releases the voice handle after the final line instead of starting another stream. Registered by Casino_Slot_BuildPayoutSequence on animation slot +0x4DC.
evidence: Literal 0x00328AC4 -> 0x0075E14C is stored in a 0x2F-byte node and registered at self+0x4DC; slot +8 = 0x006D5AF4 Ui_MessageVoice_FinishLine4 (there is no UpdateLine4 in the image, see the eight siblings at 0x006D4EDC..0x006D5938); literal 0x003B6BE0 in maybe_Ui_SlotWindow_ReelStopSequence uses the same table for its case-4 line.

name: g_slotWinTextCycleNodeVtable
comment: Win-text id cycling node: pushes a new string id on the first and 0x49th step, plays the matching SEs and finishes when the text object stops animating (exec maybe_Ui_UpdateTextIdProgression). Added by Casino_Slot_BuildPayoutSequence on animation slot +0x4F4.
evidence: Literal 0x00328E38 -> 0x00760458, stored in a 0x17-byte node registered at self+0x4F4 by Casino_Slot_BuildPayoutSequence; slot +8 = 0x002CFDDC maybe_Ui_UpdateTextIdProgression, whose body compares self+0x10 with 0 and 0x49 and calls Sound_PlaySeCached for the two text changes.

name: g_slotDigitRollNodeVtable
comment: Five-digit rolling-counter animation node: exec maybe_Ui_DigitRoll_Update scrolls the five payout digits over 0x2E frames and plays a SE at steps 0 and 10. It is the first node added by Casino_Slot_BuildPayoutSequence (animation slot +0x464).
evidence: Literal 0x00328A98 -> 0x0076046C; Casino_Slot_BuildPayoutSequence writes it to the node at self+0x464; slot +8 = 0x002CFE5C maybe_Ui_DigitRoll_Update, which loops i<5 with `i*-5 + self->f_10`, converts the scroll to float and returns `0x2E < counter`; its header calls it a five-digit rolling counter.

name: g_slotWinTextLayoutNodeVtable
comment: Win-message layout node: exec maybe_Ui_TextBuild_Start lays out the up-to-three parts of the message, plays SE 0xE70 when the third part begins and finishes after 50 frames. Registered by Casino_Slot_BuildPayoutSequence on animation slot +0x50C.
evidence: Literal 0x00328E40 -> 0x00762F88 is stored in a 0x1B-byte node registered at self+0x50C; slot +8 = 0x00311898 maybe_Ui_TextBuild_Start (calls maybe_Text_LayoutKernParts for parts 0/1/2, plays Sound_PlaySeCached(...,0xE70) at counter 3, returns done at 0x32).

name: g_slotWinLineANodeVtable
comment: Win-line A presentation node: on its first call it hides the spinning symbols, resets the payout rows and evaluates the paylines through Casino_Slot_EvaluateWinLineA, playing a win SE if a line pays; afterwards it runs a two-state counter.
evidence: Literal 0x00328AB0 -> 0x00762F9C; Casino_Slot_BuildPayoutSequence stores it in a 0x17-byte node at self+0x4A0; slot +8 = 0x006E232C Casino_Slot_UpdateWinLineA (header: 'evaluates row A (reels from index 1, symbol array base +0x4D) for up to three paylines', calls Casino_Slot_HideSymbols and maybe_Casino_Slot_ResetRows).

name: g_slotWinLineBNodeVtable
comment: Win-line B presentation node (row B of the payline evaluation). Same one-shot hide/reset/evaluate pattern as win line A; registered by Casino_Slot_BuildPayoutSequence on animation slot +0x4B8.
evidence: Literal 0x00328AB8 -> 0x00762FB0 stored in a 0x17-byte node at self+0x4B8; slot +8 = 0x006E25F8 Casino_Slot_UpdateWinLineB, the row-B sibling of 0x006E232C in the same 20-byte-stride handler table at 0x00762FA4.

name: g_slotWinLineCNodeVtable
comment: Win-line C presentation node (row C of the payline evaluation). Same one-shot hide/reset/evaluate pattern as win line A; registered by Casino_Slot_BuildPayoutSequence on animation slot +0x4D0.
evidence: Literal 0x00328AC0 -> 0x00762FC4 stored in a 0x17-byte node at self+0x4D0; slot +8 = 0x006E28C4 Casino_Slot_UpdateWinLineC, the row-C sibling of 0x006E232C in the same handler table.

name: g_slotWinLineDNodeVtable
comment: Win-line D presentation node (row D / default row of the payline evaluation). Also the default line node that maybe_Ui_SlotWindow_ReelStopSequence appends when no reel case matched.
evidence: Literal 0x00328E34 -> 0x00762FD8 stored in a 0x17-byte node at self+0x4E8 by Casino_Slot_BuildPayoutSequence; literal 0x003B6AD0 uses the same table in the default branch of maybe_Ui_SlotWindow_ReelStopSequence; slot +8 = 0x006E2CD8 Casino_Slot_UpdateWinLineD.

name: g_slotDisplayScaleNodeVtable
comment: One-shot node that scales the slot display by the payout rank (Casino_Slot_GetPayoutRank returns 0/1/2 mapped to 1/10/100) and finishes immediately. Casino_Slot_BuildPayoutSequence appends it to animation slot +0x464 when the self+0x40 counter was already zero.
evidence: Literal 0x00328A9C -> 0x00766008 stored in a 0x13-byte node at self+0x464; slot +8 = 0x003802FC maybe_Ui_Window_ApplyDisplayScale, which calls Casino_Slot_GetPayoutRank, maps 0/1/2 to 1/10/100, applies it through func_0061251C and func_00405D90 and returns 1.

name: g_slotWinTransitionNodeVtable
comment: Win-presentation transition controller: waits for the message widget, starts cue 0x3A/0x3B, fades the window out and finishes. Casino_Slot_CalcPatternPayout builds it (0x3B bytes, transition object at +0x10) for the special symbol-9 payout.
evidence: Literal 0x00327204 -> 0x0076601C; Casino_Slot_CalcPatternPayout case 9 creates the node, calls maybe_Ui_Card_Ctor(node+0x10) and registers it at self+0x53C; slot +8 = 0x00380398 maybe_Ui_Window_WaitAndStartTransition (Ui_Transition_CreateFadeQuad(&self->f_10), cues 0x3A/0x3B, maybe_Ui_Transition_Start, 0x50-frame wait).

name: g_slotDelegateNodeVtable
comment: One-shot node that invokes the pointer-to-member-function stored at node+0x10/+0x14 (exec Ui_Delegate_Invoke) and reports done when the call returns. Casino_Slot_BuildPayoutSequence uses it for the jackpot action with g_slotJackpotDelegate.
evidence: Literal 0x00328E48 -> 0x00766030 stored in a 0x1B-byte node at self+0x548; slot +8 = 0x0038060C Ui_Delegate_Invoke, which reads node+0x10 (function) and node+0x14 (this/adjust), calls it and returns 1; the same node gets the two words of g_slotJackpotDelegate copied from literal 0x00328E4C.

name: g_slotWinMessageRowsNodeVtable
comment: Win-message row animation node: lays out up to three message rows, starts cue 0x3A/0x3B/0x3C and finishes when the message widget stops animating (exec maybe_Ui_MessageWindow_UpdateRows). Registered by Casino_Slot_BuildPayoutSequence on animation slot +0x518.
evidence: Literal 0x00328E44 -> 0x00766044 stored in a 0x1B-byte node at self+0x518; slot +8 = 0x00380690 maybe_Ui_MessageWindow_UpdateRows, which calls maybe_Ui_MessageWindow_SelectRowStyle for rows 0..2, starts cues 0x3A/0x3B/0x3C from self+0x14 and returns func_00284D88(ui+0x610)^1.

name: g_casinoSlotVtable
comment: Class table of the Casino_Slot object (the 5880-byte slot-machine part that the casino window embeds at +0x11C). Word 0 is 0 and the dispatch slots start at +4: delete stub 0x00394768, maybe_Ui_CounterWidget_SetValue, then Casino_Slot_InitPanes (+0x10), ReleaseEffects (+0x14) and RenderReels (+0x18).
evidence: Casino_Slot_Ctor (0x0039467C) writes 0x00766DC4 to object+0x11C (`*(u32*)((u8*)result + 0x11c) = 0x00766DC4` in the raw C); structs.json class Casino_Slot lists vtable 0x00766DC8 (= this word +4) with slots 0x00394768, 0x0046C504, 0x00393C04 Casino_Slot_InitPanes, 0x003940C4 ReleaseEffects, 0x0039439C RenderReels; retail words +0x28/+0x2C are the zero header of the next table.

name: g_slotPayoutSequenceNodeVtable
comment: Credit/payout presentation sequence: at frame 0 it starts the payout animation and its SE, at 0x14 switches the machine to the payout display state, at 0x50 plays the win/lose SE 3 or 4 and rebinds the control, then waits for the payout animation. Node+0x10 is the amount and +0x14 the frame counter.
evidence: Literal 0x003271F4 -> 0x00768D2C; Casino_Slot_CalcPatternPayout case 7 builds a 0x1F-byte node with +0x10 = payout and registers it at self+0x524; slot +8 = 0x003B65EC maybe_Ui_SlotWindow_PayoutSequence, which compares self->f_14 with 0x14/0x50 and passes self->f_10 to func_003280C0(machine,3|4,...).

name: g_slotReelStopSequenceNodeVtable
comment: Reel-stop sequence: writes the reel result, plays the stop SE and after 0x29 frames attaches the per-line result object for the reel selected by machine+0x53. Node+0x10 is the frame counter; registered by Casino_Slot_BuildPayoutSequence on animation slot +0x500.
evidence: Literal 0x00328E3C -> 0x00768D40 stored in a 0x17-byte node at self+0x500; slot +8 = 0x003B6768 maybe_Ui_SlotWindow_ReelStopSequence (writes machine->f_4C[machine->f_53], plays SE g_003B6AB8, waits 0x29 frames, then a switch on machine->f_53 registers one of the five 0x2F-byte line nodes).

name: g_slotMachineStateNodeVtable
comment: One-shot slot-machine command: refreshes the payout display from map state, copies the request flags into Casino_Slot+0x171/+0x173 and advances the machine to state 8. It is the last node Casino_Slot_BuildPayoutSequence registers (animation slot +0x560) and has no data fields of its own.
evidence: Literal 0x00328E54 -> 0x00768D54 stored in a 0x13-byte node at self+0x560; slot +8 = 0x003B6BF8 maybe_Ui_SlotMachine_ExecState (N_027 header cites vtable 0x00768D5C, i.e. this word +8; the function calls func_00405F4C/00405D90, writes +0x171/+0x173, then func_003280C0(*args,8,0) and returns 1).

name: g_slotDisplayByte173NodeVtable
comment: One-shot node that writes its byte at +0x10 into Casino_Slot+0x173 (one of the two bet/credit digit fields) and finishes. Casino_Slot_BuildPayoutSequence creates it with the decremented self+0x40 counter; maybe_Ui_SlotMachine_ExecState refreshes the same field from self+0x40.
evidence: Literal 0x00328A90 -> 0x00768D68 stored in a 0x17-byte node with +0x10 = self->f_40 - 1; slot +8 = 0x003B6D84 (ARM: ldr r0,[r1]; ldr r1,[r2,#0x10]; ldr r0,[r0,#0x10]; strb r1,[r0,#0x173]; mov r0,#1); ExecState does `*(char*)(display+0x173) = (char)*(u32*)(*args+0x40)`.

name: g_slotDisplayByte171NodeVtable
comment: One-shot node that writes its byte at +0x10 into Casino_Slot+0x171 (the other bet/credit digit field) and finishes. Casino_Slot_BuildPayoutSequence creates it with the decremented self+0x3C counter; maybe_Ui_SlotMachine_ExecState refreshes the same field from self+0x3C.
evidence: Literal 0x00328A94 -> 0x0076B7B8 stored in a 0x17-byte node with +0x10 = self->f_3C - 1; slot +8 = 0x003EB614 (ARM: ldr r0,[r1]; ldr r1,[r2,#0x10]; ldr r0,[r0,#0x10]; strb r1,[r0,#0x171]; mov r0,#1); ExecState does `*(char*)(display+0x171) = (char)*(u32*)(*args+0x3c)`.

name: g_slotWidgetPollNodeVtable
comment: Short poll node: increments its +0x10 counter and finishes after 5 frames or as soon as the slot widget at Casino_Slot+0x56C reports the expected state bits. Used by Casino_Slot_BuildPayoutSequence before the win text (animation slot +0x470).
evidence: Literal 0x00328AA0 -> 0x0076B7CC stored in a 0x17-byte node at self+0x470; slot +8 = 0x003EB648 (ARM: ldr r2,[r0,#0x10]; cmp r2,#5; str r3,[r0,#0x10]; bge done; ldrh r0,[ctx_obj+0x580]; mask 0xFE00/0xFD; bne done; else return 0).

name: g_slotPayoutCounterNodeVtable
comment: Payout count-up animation node: snapshots the medal counter, interpolates the seven gauge segments toward the new total and plays the coin SE until the value is reached (exec Ui_SlotWindow_UpdatePayoutAnim). Its fields are +0x10 state, +0x18 snapshot, +0x1C running flag and +0x1D gauge-started flag.
evidence: Literal 0x00328E50 -> 0x0076E2AC stored in a 0x23-byte node at self+0x554 (fields +0x10..+0x1D zeroed); slot +8 = 0x004060C4 Ui_SlotWindow_UpdatePayoutAnim, which uses self->f_10/f_18/f_1C/f_1D, the 7x0x50 gauge array and g_00406448 (9999999).

name: g_slotWinSequenceNodeVtable
comment: Long slot win-result timeline: at frame 0x14 it stops all reels and applies the row state, at 0x19/0x1E/0x23/0x28/0x2D it sets the five reel states, at 0x64 it starts win state 6 or 7 with the amount from +0x10, then waits for the widget and finishes. Built by Casino_Slot_CalcPatternPayout for symbol 8 (animation slot +0x530).
evidence: Literal 0x003271F8 -> 0x00771B24; Casino_Slot_CalcPatternPayout case 8 creates a 0x1F-byte node with +0x10 = gauge increment and +0x18 = 0, registered at self+0x530; slot +8 = 0x0045E848, whose (misleading) name Ui_SlotMachine_UpdateInput hides a 0x65-frame script: frame 0x14 stop reels, 0x19/0x1E/0x23/0x28/0x2D reel states 5/4/3/2/1/0, frame 0x64 func_003280C0(state 6|7,node+0x10), then polls machine+0x588.

name: g_casinoSlotDisplayVtable
comment: Class vtable of the casino slot display / digit-panel object installed by Casino_SlotMachine_DigitPanel_Ctor. Slots +0/+4 are the deleting/non-deleting destructor, +8 Ui_Widget_ReleaseSub, +0x24 maybe_Casino_Slot_UpdateSpinState; the 0x100-byte objects hold eight 0x10-byte digit colour groups at +0x20..+0xFF.
evidence: Literal 0x004AD998 -> 0x00776084 is the first word the ctor stores; words: +0 = 0x004AD9B8 (Casino_SlotDisplay_Dtor deleting part), +4 = 0x004AD99C, +8 = 0x00291220 Ui_Widget_ReleaseSub, +0x24 = 0x004ACDD0 maybe_Casino_Slot_UpdateSpinState; Casino_SlotDisplay_Dtor's header and structs.json's Casino_PokerWindow/Ui vtable style agree on the 10-slot layout.

name: g_casinoPokerWindowVtable
comment: Class vtable of Casino_PokerWindow (the 560-byte poker window): +0 Casino_PokerWindow_DtorBase, +4 Casino_PokerWindow_Dtor (deleting), then the shared Ui_Widget virtuals, +0x20 Ui_PokerScoreList_Init and +0x24 the list row animation. Installed by the poker window constructor and restored by both destructors.
evidence: structs.json class Casino_PokerWindow lists vtable 0x0077A2B8 with exactly these 10 slots; Casino_PokerWindow_Dtor (0x004DC454) does `*self = g_004dc49c` (literal -> 0x0077A2B8) before destroying the two 6x0x50 card arrays; Casino_PokerWindow_DtorBase is slot 0; literals 0x004DC44C/0x004DC49C/0x004DC4E8 all resolve here.

name: g_casinoSlotDetachedObjectNames
comment: Three layout-object names that Casino_Slot_InitPanes looks up and detaches at start-up: "win_talk", "win_yesno" and "coinget". The slot machine does not use those three sub-objects, they are leftovers of the shared casino layout.
evidence: Words at 0x007AA048/4C/50 point at the ASCII strings "win_talk" (0x00785990), "win_yesno" (0x0078599C) and "coinget" (0x007859A8); Casino_Slot_InitPanes does `iVar1 = g_00393ff0; for (i=0;i<3;i++) func_0053D4C4(&self->f_98, *(u32*)(iVar1 + i*4))` and then detaches the returned sprite (Ui_ChildSprite_Detach).

name: g_slotDigitLightAnimNames
comment: Animation names "light_l", "light_c" and "light_r" played while the slot digit counter steps: maybe_Casino_Slot_StepDigitAnim indexes this table with the current digit index (index-1 when counting down) and plays the clip on the digit panel.
evidence: Words at 0x007AA158/5C/60 point at "light_l" (0x00785AE0), "light_c" (0x00785AB8) and "light_r" (0x00785B04); maybe_Casino_Slot_StepDigitAnim loads literal 0x004ADB20 -> 0x007AA158 and calls Ui_PlayAnimByName(panel, *(u32*)(table + index*4), 0, 1), using index-1 for the decreasing branch.

name: g_slotShuffleInitFlag
comment: Once-only guard byte for the function-local static shuffle state g_slotShuffleState used by Casino_Slot_PickStopBySymbol: bit 0 becomes set after the 54-entry permutation table has been built. It is 0 in the retail image and lives in .data.
evidence: ARM in Casino_Slot_PickStopBySymbol: 0x0064C0A0 ldr r1,=0x007C22FC; ldrb r1,[r1]; tst r1,#1; bne skip-init; 0x0064C0B8 ldr r0,=0x007C22FC; blx 0x0010009C (the static-init guard helper); only then is 0x00839800 initialised.

name: g_slotShuffleState
comment: 228-byte BSS state of the function-local static shuffle used by Casino_Slot_PickStopBySymbol: a 54-entry (0x36) permutation table at +0, the seed/step word at +0xD8 and the two LCG words at +0xDC/+0xE0. It is built on first use behind g_slotShuffleInitFlag.
evidence: ARM 0x0064C0CC..0x0064C118 (after the guard) loads base 0x00839800, stores 0x09A4EC86 at +0xD8 and fills 0x36 permutation entries; the shuffle loop at 0x0064C11C.. reads/writes +0xDC and +0xE0 as the two LCG state words; literal slot 0x0064C2D8 holds 0x00839800.
